mapper.select: select USERUNIQUE,GROUPNAME,USERID,CURRENTPERIOD,STATUS from GAMEGROUPMEMBER where GROUPNAME = #{groupName} order by GROUPNAME desc

SELECT GROUPNAME,GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,YEARS,PERIODSOFONEYEAR,CURRENTPERIOD,AUTOPERIODFRESH,AUTOYEARFRESH,ENABLEAUTOPERIODFRESH,ENABLEAUTOYEARFRESH FROM HIS_GAMEGROUP where CURRENTPERIOD>0 and teacherid = #{adminID}
select CURRENTPERIOD from gamegroupmember where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique}
SELECT G.GROUPNAME, A.USERNAME, G.GROUPCREATERID, G.USERNUMBERS, G.YEARS, G.PERIODSOFONEYEAR, G.CURRENTPERIOD FROM GAMEGROUP G, APPROVEDUSER A WHERE G.GROUPCREATERID = A.USERID

select GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.PERIODSOFONEYEAR,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,count(*) as JOINNUMBER, USERNUMBERS-count(*) as REMANDNUMBER,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD from GAMEGROUPMEMBER,GAMEGROUP where GAMEGROUPMEMBER.GROUPNAME=GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME and GAMEGROUP.TEACHERID=#{adminID} group by GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD having USERNUMBERS-count(*)>=0

select GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.PERIODSOFONEYEAR,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,count(*) as JOINNUMBER, USERNUMBERS-count(*) as REMANDNUMBER,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD from GAMEGROUPMEMBER,GAMEGROUP where GAMEGROUPMEMBER.GROUPNAME=GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME and GAMEGROUP.TEACHERID=#{adminID} and GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID is NULL group by GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD having USERNUMBERS-count(*)>=0

select GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.PERIODSOFONEYEAR,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,count(*) as JOINNUMBER, USERNUMBERS-count(*) as REMANDNUMBER,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD from GAMEGROUPMEMBER,GAMEGROUP where GAMEGROUPMEMBER.GROUPNAME=GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME and GAMEGROUP.TEACHERID=#{adminID} and GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID is not NULL group by GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD having USERNUMBERS-count(*)>=0

SELECT GROUPNAME,GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,YEARS,PERIODSOFONEYEAR,CURRENTPERIOD,AUTOPERIODFRESH,AUTOYEARFRESH,ENABLEAUTOPERIODFRESH,ENABLEAUTOYEARFRESH FROM HIS_GAMEGROUP where CURRENTPERIOD>0 and teacherid = #{adminID}

select GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,count(*) as JOINNUMBER,USERNUMBERS-count(*) as REMANDNUMBER,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD from GAMEGROUPMEMBER,GAMEGROUP where GAMEGROUPMEMBER.GROUPNAME=GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME group by GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS,GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD having USERNUMBERS-count(*)>0 and GAMEGROUP.CURRENTPERIOD=0
select GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME,GAMEGROUP.GROUPCREATERID,USERNUMBERS from GAMEGROUPMEMBER,GAMEGROUP where GAMEGROUPMEMBER.GROUPNAME=GAMEGROUP.GROUPNAME and GAMEGROUPMEMBER.STATUS=10
select count(*) nums from GameGroupMember where groupName = #{groupName}
select count(*) nums from GameGroupMember where groupName = #{groupName} and status=1
select YEARS from GAMEGROUP where GROUPNAME=#{groupName}
select count(userid) from gamegroupmember where GROUPNAME=#{groupName}

select GROUPNAME,GROUPCREATERID,TEACHERID,USERNUMBERS,YEARS,PERIODSOFONEYEAR,CURRENTPERIOD,AUTOPERIODFRESH,AUTOYEARFRESH,ENABLEAUTOPERIODFRESH,ENABLEAUTOYEARFRESH from GAMEGROUP where GROUPNAME in (select GROUPNAME from gamegroupmember where userunique=#{userUnique})
select GROUPNAME from gamegroupmember where userunique=#{userUnique}
select gamegroupmember.currentperiod,periodsofoneyear,years from gamegroupmember,gamegroup where gamegroupmember.groupname=gamegroup.groupname and userunique=#{userUnique}
select currentperiod from gamegroup where groupName=#{groupName}

select years*periodsofoneyear AS TotalPeriodOfGroup, gamegroupmember.currentperiod from gamegroupmember,gamegroup where userunique=#{userUnique} and gamegroup.groupname=#{groupName} and gamegroup.groupname=gamegroupmember.groupname
{#{result,mode=OUT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}=call admin_change_to_history(#{groupName,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR})}
SELECT GROUPNAME,PERIODSOFONEYEAR,YEARS,EXCELLENT,GOOD,MEAN,PASSED,FAILED from gamegroup WHERE GROUPNAME = #{groupName};
SELECT GROUPNAME,EXCELLENT,GOOD,MEAN,PASSED,FAILED from his_gamegroup WHERE GROUPNAME = #{groupName};

select DISTINCT approveduser.USERNAME,g.years ,m.USERID, m.userUnique, m.groupName, m.currentperiod, m.status, g.periodsofoneyear,a.finishadflag, a.chooseorderflag, a.finishorderflag FROM (gamegroupmember m,gamegroup g,approveduser) LEFT JOIN adstatusofuser a ON m.USERUNIQUE = a.USERUNIQUE AND a.period in ( select (floor(ggm.CURRENTPERIOD/gg.PERIODSOFONEYEAR)*gg.PERIODSOFONEYEAR+1) as period from gamegroup gg,gamegroupmember ggm where gg.groupname = ggm.groupname and ggm.groupname = #{groupName} ) where m.GROUPNAME = g.GROUPNAME AND M.USERID = approveduser.USERID and m.GROUPNAME = #{groupName}

SELECT gamegroupmember.USERID AS USERID, gamegroupmember.USERUNIQUE AS USERUNIQUE, gamegroupmember.GROUPNAME AS GROUPNAME, approveduser.SID AS STUDENTNO, approveduser.USERNAME AS STUDENTNAME
FROM approveduser, gamegroupmember where gamegroupmember.GROUPNAME = #{groupName} AND approveduser.USERID = gamegroupmember.USERID;
